data.summary: Added Light/Dark/System theme support: Tailwind class dark mode, pure theme.js logic module, pre-paint inline script in Layout, ThemeToggle button next to the eye button (desktop and mobile), Home/About in a dark rounded box, theme-aware header/body, and global .dark overrides in global.css for existing light-only surface/text/border classes (instead of per-file dark: variants). Unit tests for theme.js added. Commands could not be run in this environment.

changedFiles.purpose: Pure theme logic (normalize, cycle, resolve, storage, apply)
Inline pre-paint theme script and dark body classes
Theme cycling button with live system-change listener
Dark nav box for Home/About, ThemeToggle beside PrivacyToggle, theme-aware nav surface
Dark-mode overrides for existing light-only utility classes

testsAdded.description: normalizeTheme, nextTheme cycle, resolveIsDark matrix, storage round-trip and throwing storage, applyTheme class/colorScheme
